info.name: TravelBestie Manager API
info.description:
Complete test collection for the TravelBestie Manager REST API.

## Setup
1. Set `baseUrl` (default: `http://localhost:3000`)
2. Set `rsaPublicKeyBase64` — the RSA public key in SPKI format, base64-encoded (no PEM headers). Required for all Auth requests.
3. Optionally adjust `testUserEmail`, `testUserPassword`, `testUserName`.

## Run order
Requires **Postman v10+** (top-level `await` in pre-request scripts, Web Crypto API).

For the full happy-path flow run folders in order: Auth → Trips → Comments → Karma.
`token` and `tripId` are saved automatically as collection variables.

## Auth encryption
Login and Register bodies contain `encryptedPayload` (RSA-OAEP + SHA-256). Each Auth pre-request script encrypts the plaintext credentials using `rsaPublicKeyBase64` before the request fires.

exec: const enc = async p => { const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', Uint8Array.from(atob(pub), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer, {name:'RSA-OAEP', hash:'SHA-256'}, false, ['encrypt']); const e = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'RSA-OAEP'}, k, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(p))); return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(e))); };

const enc = async p => { const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', Uint8Array.from(atob(pub), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer, {name:'RSA-OAEP', hash:'SHA-256'}, false, ['encrypt']); const e = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'RSA-OAEP'}, k, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(p))); return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(e))); };
// Pre-register the email so it's definitely taken
const firstEnc = await enc({ name: 'First User', email: takenEmail, password: 'testpass123' });

await new Promise(resolve => pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl') + '/auth/register', method: 'POST', header: [{ key: 'Content-Type', value: 'application/json' }], body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ encryptedPayload: firstEnc }) } }, () => resolve()));
// Main request uses the same email — should get 400
pm.collectionVariables.set('encryptedPayload', await enc({ name: 'Second User', email: takenEmail, password: 'otherpass123' }));

const enc = async p => { const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', Uint8Array.from(atob(pub), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer, {name:'RSA-OAEP', hash:'SHA-256'}, false, ['encrypt']); const e = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'RSA-OAEP'}, k, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(p))); return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(e))); };

const enc = async p => { const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', Uint8Array.from(atob(pub), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer, {name:'RSA-OAEP', hash:'SHA-256'}, false, ['encrypt']); const e = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'RSA-OAEP'}, k, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(p))); return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(e))); };
pm.test('Error is encryptedPayload required', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.equal('encryptedPayload is required'));
pm.test('Error is invalid payload', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.equal('Invalid encrypted payload'));

const enc = async p => { const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', Uint8Array.from(atob(pub), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer, {name:'RSA-OAEP', hash:'SHA-256'}, false, ['encrypt']); const e = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'RSA-OAEP'}, k, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(p))); return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(e))); };
// Ensure user exists before login (idempotent — 400 if already registered is fine)

await new Promise(resolve => pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl') + '/auth/register', method: 'POST', header: [{ key: 'Content-Type', value: 'application/json' }], body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ encryptedPayload: regEnc }) } }, () => resolve()));

const enc = async p => { const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', Uint8Array.from(atob(pub), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer, {name:'RSA-OAEP', hash:'SHA-256'}, false, ['encrypt']); const e = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'RSA-OAEP'}, k, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(p))); return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(e))); };

const enc = async p => { const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', Uint8Array.from(atob(pub), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer, {name:'RSA-OAEP', hash:'SHA-256'}, false, ['encrypt']); const e = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'RSA-OAEP'}, k, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(p))); return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(e))); };
pm.test('Error is encryptedPayload required', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.equal('encryptedPayload is required'));

item.name: Post Comment - Spoofed Name Ignored
item.description: Sends a `name` field in the body that differs from the JWT name. The server must ignore the body name and use the JWT name.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "HACKER",
  "text": "I tried to spoof the author name.",
  "rating": 4,
  "color": "#34D399",
  "date": "Apr 28"
}

exec: pm.test('Name is from JWT not body', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('testUserName')));

item.name: Post Comment - Second on Same Attraction
item.description: A second comment on paris_0 is allowed, but does NOT grant additional karma (+1 was already awarded by the first comment).

exec: pm.test('Comment saved', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().text).to.equal('Even better the second time!'));

item.description: Comment on a new attractionId grants another +1 karma because this is the first comment on this attraction.
